table.name: TLGNU_USER_SHIPPINGPOINT_ACC
table.description: Access Control/Data restriction table. Defines the Shippingpoints (tlgnc_shippingpoint) a user has access to.

column.name: SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. The shippingpoint for which access is granted.

column.name: USER_PLANT_ACC_ID
column.description: FK tlgnu_user_plant_acc. With this constraint, we enforce, that any shippingpoint restriction requires that its plant is also restricted. I.e. you cannot create a shippingpoint restriction, if there is not already a restriction on the respective plant.
